overview: At the Theatre the plot was The Shrew, this day, at two of the clock. Your side was an old man's. There was no name of a part on the peg worth taking home to the letter.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Played the side, and left it unnamed.

assets.name: The Shrew
assets.disposition: Took an old man's side in The Shrew

summary: Took an old man's side in The Shrew
